description: This Java class 'DetachedSensor' provides a GUI component for displaying and mocking sensors within a larger application. It creates a JFrame with gauges, allows mock voltage control via sliders, and manages sensor state changes and configuration persistence.

classes.name: DetachedSensor
classes.description: A GUI component class managing sensor display and mock control sliders in a separate window.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Initializes and opens a new DetachedSensor window based on configuration data.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Saves the current configuration of the sensor window to a node.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the sensor window at the specified mouse event location.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Updates the sensor displayed in the GUI when the sensor type changes.

methods.name: showMockControl
methods.description: Updates the mock control panel based on whether the sensor is mockable.
